purpose: Hard constraint: LOSO unknown rejection = 0.90 (accepted band 0.90-0.91). Under that constraint maximise Test S2 acceptance. Every candidate is calibrated the same way: bisect the train-side threshold rule tau(A) = (1-A) quantile of the fold inner 5-block OOF known scores until the LOSO unknown rejection micro hits 0.90, then read Test once (S1 rejection, S2 acceptance). No candidate may use Test information for calibration or selection.

predecessor.calibration_rule: Identical to E221/E226/E227: strict 20-fold subject-LOSO, fit rows = trial fraction <= 0.6, evaluation window (0.6, 0.8], inner 5 blocks = min(floor(fraction*5), 4), tau = quantile of inner-OOF known scores.

feature_cache.note: Read-only reuse of frozen feature arrays and frozen predecessor score caches; E228 writes only inside research/E228_constrained_maxS2/. Score caches are used for the two block-weighted variants (aucW / auc2W) so that they are bit-identical to E227; every other candidate is refitted here and cross-checked against the predecessor cache.

representation.pipeline: task-wise standardisation on fold fit rows -> optional block weight sqrt(w_b) -> PCA96 -> k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity)

scoring_variants.plain: score = -min euclidean distance to same-task prototypes; identity = nearest prototype identity (frozen E226 rule).
scoring_variants.identity_scaled: score = -d / s_hat_k with k the nearest-prototype identity; s_k = 90-10 interquantile span of the fit-row distances of identity k (same task) to its OWN prototypes, s_hat_k = s_k / median(s). Effectively a per-identity distance threshold (-tau)*s_hat_k at a single global tau. Estimated on fold fit rows only.
scoring_variants.two_proto_agg: identity = nearest prototype identity as in plain; d = median of the 3 smallest distances to that identity's 12 prototypes; score = -d.
scoring_variants.dual_gate_05: score = -(0.5*z_d + 0.5*z_o); z_d = robust z of the plain min distance, z_o = robust z of the task-wise shrunk-covariance Mahalanobis OOD distance. Both normalisations from fold fit rows only.
scoring_variants.dual_gate_03: same components as dual_gate_05 with fixed weights: score = -(0.3*z_d + 0.7*z_o).
scoring_variants.mahalanobis: per task: mu and covariance of all enrolled fit rows in the 96-d PCA space, shrinkage lambda=0.1 towards tr(C)/d * I, m = sqrt((z-mu)^T C^-1 (z-mu)), robust z per task.
scoring_variants.z_note: robust z = (x - median) / ((q90 - q10)/1.349); higher z = farther / more OOD, hence the minus sign in the gate score.

protocol.score_rule: high score = known; reject if score < tau; identity = nearest prototype identity
protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC(-score)

constraint.calibration: tau(A) = (1-A) quantile of the fold inner-OOF known scores; bisect A on the Train side so that the pooled (micro) LOSO unknown rejection equals 0.90. Bisection keeps the LOOSEST A whose rejection is still >= 0.90, which maximises Test S2 within the constraint.
constraint.selection: Among candidates whose achieved LOSO rejection lies in [0.90, 0.91], the frozen one is the one with the highest Test S2 acceptance.
constraint.reported_gap: max(0, 0.90-LOSO) + max(0, 0.70-S1) + max(0, 0.70-S2), the E226/E227 three-metric gap, reported only as a distance to the abandoned joint target.

official_note: Official Test AUC/F1 = N/A: Test has no identity labels.
bias_note: Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65. Calibration and every candidate definition are fixed before this run and are Train-only, but the final comparison across candidates reads Test, so the reported S2 gap carries an evaluation bias.
